• Combine theory and practice and get to know the company better
• Deepen your knowledge and lay the foundation for your professional career Your talents and experience
• Studies at a Swiss university of applied sciences or university in the fields of (business) informatics, (business) engineering or electrical engineering

descriptionByLocale.it:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo il mondo reale e digitale s. Siemens è una società tecnologica leader (che impiega circa 6.000 persone in Svizzera / 320.000 a livello globale). Forniamo soluzioni pionieristiche per la tecnologia degli edifici, l'energia, la mobilità, la sanità e il settore industriale. Le nuove responsabilità
• Scrivi la tua tesi di laurea, master o dottorato con una delle principali aziende tecnologiche nel campo della digitalizzazione
• Combinare la teoria e la pratica e conoscere meglio l'azienda
• Approfondisci la tua conoscenza e getti le basi per la tua carriera professionale
• Studi presso un'università svizzera di scienze applicate o universitarie nei settori dell'informatica (business), dell'ingegneria o dell'ingegneria elettrica
• Rapida comprensione, stile di lavoro strutturato e indipendente e capacità di lavorare in un team
• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese
• Inizia con l'accordo Chi e dove siamo Scopri perché Siemens viene scelto ogni anno come uno dei datori di lavoro più popolari in Svizzera, e ottenere una prima impressione di un nuovo ambiente di lavoro e le persone che potrebbero essere i vostri nuovi colleghi di lavoro. Homepage Siemens come datore di lavoro non vedo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda. Isidora Talent Acquisizione

jobs.description:
Nous relions les mondes réels et numériques en collaboration avec nos clients. Siemens est un leader technologique qui emploie environ 6000 personnes. Technique du bâtiment, énergie, mobilité, santé et industrie : nos solutions innovantes portent sur de nombreux domaines et façonnent le monde de demain. En tant que technicien·ne de service senior, vous avez la possibilité d’être votre propre chef et de profiter d’une grande liberté dans la planification des interventions clients. Vous aimeriez aussi contribuer aux prochaines innovations et améliorer la vie de millions de personnes en Suisse ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Déposez votre candidature dès aujourd’hui en tant que Technicien senior contrôle d’accès (f/h/d) et commence dès que possible – votre équipe se réjouisse de vous accueillir ! Lieu de travail : veuillez noter que nous recherchons deux technicien·nes senior en contrôle d’accès : l’un pour notre site de Plan-les-Ouates (GE) et l’autre pouvant être basé à St‑Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) ou Renens (VD). Pas de CV sous la main ? Aucun problème ! Avec nous, vous pouvez commencer votre candidature sur WhatsApp et nous contacter facilement et directement. Vos nouvelles tâches
• Former et accompagner les équipes techniques (préparer les supports, mise en service d’installations de contrôle d’accès)
• Accompagner les équipes de vente dans l’élaboration de concepts majeurs en phase pré-sales
• Contribuer à la maintenance, aux réparations, à l’entretien et au dépannage des installations (en assurant le service de piquet ainsi que le respect des directives de qualité et de sécurité au travail)
• Réaliser des proofs of concept sur les nouvelles technologies de sureté
• Effectuer les tâches administratives telles que rapports d’intervention, conformément aux processus de qualité et de sécurité
• Conseiller, assister et accompagner les clients tout au long de leurs projets Vos talents et votre expérience
• Formation technique : électricien·ne, automaticien·ne, télématicien·ne ou qualification équivalente
• Excellente maîtrise des systèmes de contrôle d’accès et des technologies associées (badges, biométrie, etc.)
• Solide compréhension des environnements informatiques et réseaux (serveurs, switches, etc.)
• Sens aigu de la qualité, orientation clients et résultats
• De nature enthousiaste, proactive et communicative
• Langue maternelle française, avec idéalement de bonnes connaissances d’une deuxième langue (allemand ou anglais) Vos avantages
• Votre propre voiture électrique (que vous pourrez également utiliser à titre privé)
• Travail indépendant et flexible, et liberté de planifier vos interventions
• Nombreuses opportunités de développement et de formation continue
• Formations continues rémunérées
• Retrouve tous les avantages ici Notre culture d’entreprise – ton nouvel environnement de travail La culture de Siemens Suisse est bien plus qu’un simple environnement de travail : elle est au cœur de notre collaboration quotidienne et la clé de notre succès. Siemens Suisse offre un environnement de travail tourné vers l’avenir, faisant la part belle à l’innovation, au développement durable et à l’épanouissement personnel. Nous nous distinguons par notre responsabilité individuelle, l’égalité des chances et la diversité, qui permettent à chaque collaborateur et collaboratrice de s’investir de manière authentique. Nous mettons en œuvre des modèles de travail flexibles et le travail mobile afin de permettre à notre personnel de trouver un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée. Retrouve plus d’informations et découvre avec notre quiz culture si vous convenez à Siemens ! « Siemens est synonyme de qualité, d’innovation et de durabilité! Je m’identifie pleinement à ces valeurs. » (Process Manager) Actualités et stories Découvre par vous-même à quel point les innovations technologiques peuvent déjà transformer notre vie. Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur les projets qui peuvent être mis en œuvre à l’aide de la technologie Siemens, vous trouverez ici quelques exemples actuels . Questions fréquentes et votre interlocuteur ou interlocutrice Vous trouverez ici une synthèse des questions fréquemment posées ainsi que la possibilité de nous contacter directement. J’attends votre candidature avec impatience ! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Votre parcours vers Siemens - How we hire Information concernant le placement de personnel : pour ce poste, Siemens Suisse n’accepte pas les candidatures issues du placement de personnel. Merci de votre compréhension.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Connettiamo mondi reali e digitali in collaborazione con i nostri clienti. Siemens è un leader tecnologico che impiega circa 6.000 persone. Tecnologia costruttiva, energia, mobilità, salute e industria: le nostre soluzioni innovative abbracciano molti campi e plasmano il mondo di domani. Come tecnico di servizio senior, hai la possibilità di essere il tuo leader e godere di grande libertà nella pianificazione degli interventi dei clienti. Vorresti anche contribuire alle prossime innovazioni e migliorare la vita di milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora questo post è per voi! Applicare oggi come Senior Access Control Technician (f/h/d) e iniziare il prima possibile – il vostro team è impaziente di accogliervi! Si prega di notare che stiamo cercando due tecnici senior di controllo accessi: uno per il nostro sito Plan-les-Ouates (GE) e l'altro che può essere basato in St-Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) o Renens (VD). Le nuove attività
• Formare e accompagnare i team tecnici (preparare i supporti, commissionare i controlli di accesso)
• Sostenere i team di vendita nello sviluppo di importanti concetti pre-vendita
• Contribuisci alla manutenzione, alla riparazione, alla manutenzione e alla risoluzione dei problemi delle strutture (fornendo il servizio picket e il rispetto delle linee guida di qualità e sicurezza sul lavoro)
• Prove di concetto sulle nuove tecnologie di sicurezza
• Eseguire i compiti amministrativi come i rapporti di intervento, in conformità ai processi di qualità e sicurezza
• Consigli, assistenza e assistenza ai clienti durante i loro progetti I tuoi talenti ed esperienza
• Formazione tecnica: elettricista, automatico, telematico o equivalente
• Ottimo controllo dei sistemi di controllo degli accessi e delle tecnologie associate (cattivi, biometrie, ecc.)
• Forte comprensione degli ambienti di computer e di rete (server, interruttori, ecc.)
• Alta qualità, orientamento del cliente e risultati
• Enthusiastic, proattivo e comunicativo
• Lingua madre francese, idealmente con buona conoscenza di una seconda lingua (tedesco o inglese)
• La tua auto elettrica (che puoi anche usare privatamente)
• Autooccupazione e flessibilità e libertà di pianificare i vostri interventi
• Molte opportunità di sviluppo e formazione
• Formazione continua pagata
• Trova tutti i vantaggi qui La nostra cultura aziendale – il tuo nuovo ambiente di lavoro La cultura di Siemens Svizzera è molto più di un semplice ambiente di lavoro: è al centro della nostra collaborazione quotidiana e della chiave del nostro successo. Siemens Svizzera offre un ambiente di lavoro all'avanguardia, con un focus sull'innovazione, lo sviluppo sostenibile e lo sviluppo personale. Ci distinguono per la nostra responsabilità individuale, l'uguaglianza di opportunità e la diversità, che permettono a ogni dipendente di investire in modo autentico. Realizziamo modelli di lavoro flessibili e lavoro mobile per consentire al nostro personale di bilanciare il lavoro e la privacy. Trova maggiori informazioni e scopri con la nostra cultura quiz se sei adatto per Siemens! " Siemens è sinonimo di qualità, innovazione e sostenibilità! Mi identifico pienamente con questi valori. » (Process Manager) Notizie e Storie Scoprite da soli come le innovazioni tecnologiche possono già trasformare la nostra vita. Se volete saperne di più sui progetti che possono essere implementati utilizzando la tecnologia Siemens, qui troverete alcuni esempi attuali. Domande frequenti e il tuo interlocutore Qui troverete un riassunto delle domande frequenti e la possibilità di contattarci direttamente. Non vedo l'ora della sua applicazione! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Il vostro viaggio a Siemens - Come assumere Informazioni sul posizionamento del personale: Siemens Svizzera non accetta applicazioni dal posizionamento del personale. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We connect real and digital worlds in collaboration with our customers. Siemens is a technological leader who employs approximately 6,000 people. Building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry: our innovative solutions span many fields and shape the world of tomorrow. As a senior service technician, you have the opportunity to be your own leader and enjoy great freedom in the planning of client interventions. Would you also like to contribute to the next innovations and improve the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then this post is for you! Apply today as Senior Access Control Technician (f/h/d) and start as soon as possible – your team is looking forward to welcoming you! Please note that we are looking for two senior access control technicians: one for our Plan-les-Ouates (GE) site and the other which can be based in St-Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) or Renens (VD). Your new tasks
• Train and accompany technical teams (preparing supports, commissioning access control facilities)
• Support sales teams in the development of major pre-sales concepts
• Contribute to the maintenance, repair, maintenance and troubleshooting of facilities (by providing picket service and compliance with quality and safety guidelines at work)
• Making proofs of concept on new safety technologies
• Perform administrative tasks such as intervention reports, in accordance with quality and safety processes
• Advise, assist and support clients throughout their projects Your talents and experience
• Technical training: electrician, automatician, telematician or equivalent qualification
• Excellent control of access control systems and associated technologies (badges, biometrics, etc.)
• Strong understanding of computer and network environments (servers, switches, etc.)
• High quality, customer orientation and results
• Enthusiastic, proactive and communicative
• French mother tongue, ideally with good knowledge of a second language (German or English) Your Benefits
• Your own electric car (which you can also use privately)
• Self-employment and flexibility, and freedom to plan your interventions
• Many opportunities for development and further training
• Paid continuing training
• Find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment Siemens Switzerland's culture is much more than just a work environment: it is at the heart of our daily collaboration and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a forward-looking working environment, with a focus on innovation, sustainable development and personal development. We distinguish ourselves by our individual responsibility, equality of opportunity and diversity, which allow each employee to invest in a genuine way. We implement flexible work models and mobile work to allow our staff to balance work and privacy. Find more information and discover with our culture quiz if you are suitable for Siemens! " Siemens stands for quality, innovation and sustainability! I fully identify with these values. » (Process Manager) News and Stories Discover for yourself how technological innovations can already transform our lives. If you want to know more about the projects that can be implemented using Siemens technology, here you will find some current examples. Frequently asked questions and your interlocutor Here you will find a summary of frequently asked questions and the possibility to contact us directly. I'm looking forward to your application! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Your journey to Siemens - How we hire Information on the placement of staff: Siemens Switzerland does not accept applications from the placement of staff. Thank you for your understanding.

Wir verbinden reale und digitale Welten in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Siemens ist Technologieführer und beschäftigt rund 6.000 Mitarbeiter. Gebäudetechnik, Energie, Mobilität, Gesundheit und Industrie: Unsere innovativen Lösungen umfassen viele Bereiche und prägen die Welt von morgen. Als Senior Service Techniker haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre eigene Führungskraft zu sein und genießen große Freiheit bei der Planung von Kundeninterventionen. Möchten Sie auch zu den nächsten Innovationen beitragen und das Leben von Millionen Menschen in der Schweiz verbessern? Dieser Post ist für dich! Bewerben Sie sich noch heute als Senior Access Control Techniker (w/h/d) und starten Sie so schnell wie möglich – Ihr Team freut sich auf Sie! Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir zwei leitende Zugangskontrolltechniker suchen: einen für unseren Plan-les-Ouates (GE) Standort und den anderen, der in St-Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) oder Renens (VD) ansässig sein kann. Ihre neuen Aufgaben
• Trainieren und begleiten Sie technische Teams (Vorbereitung von Unterstützung, Inbetriebnahme von Zugangskontrolleinrichtungen)
• Unterstützung von Vertriebsteams bei der Entwicklung wichtiger Pre-Sales-Konzepte
• Beitrag zur Wartung, Reparatur, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung von Einrichtungen (durch Bereitstellung von Streikposten und Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien bei der Arbeit)
• Mache Machbarkeitsnachweise für neue Sicherheitstechnologien
• Führen Sie administrative Aufgaben wie Interventionsberichte in Übereinstimmung mit Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsprozessen durch
• Beratung, Unterstützung und Unterstützung von Kunden während ihrer Projekte Ihre Talente und Erfahrungen
• Technische Ausbildung: Elektriker, Automatiker, Telematiker oder gleichwertige Qualifikation
• Hervorragende Kontrolle von Zugangskontrollsystemen und zugehörigen Technologien (Badges, Biometrie usw.)
• Starkes Verständnis von Computer- und Netzwerkumgebungen (Server, Switches usw.)
• Hohe Qualität, Kundenorientierung und Ergebnisse
• Enthusiatisch, proaktiv und kommunikativ
• Französische Muttersprache, idealerweise mit guten Kenntnissen einer zweiten Sprache (Deutsch oder Englisch) Ihre Vorteile
• Ihr eigenes Elektroauto (das Sie auch privat nutzen können)
• Selbständigkeit und Flexibilität und die Freiheit, Ihre Interventionen zu planen
• Viele Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und Weiterbildung
• Bezahlte Weiterbildung
• Alle Vorteile finden Sie hier Unsere Unternehmenskultur – Ihre neue Arbeitswelt Die Kultur von Siemens Schweiz ist viel mehr als nur ein Arbeitsumfeld: Sie steht im Mittelpunkt unserer täglichen Zusammenarbeit und ist der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsweisendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Fokus auf Innovation, nachhaltige Entwicklung und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir zeichnen uns durch unsere individuelle Verantwortung, Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt aus, die es jedem Mitarbeiter ermöglichen, wirklich zu investieren. Wir implementieren flexible Arbeitsmodelle und mobile Arbeit, damit unsere Mitarbeiter Arbeit und Privatsphäre in Einklang bringen können. Erfahren Sie mehr und entdecken Sie mit unserem Kulturquiz, ob Sie für Siemens geeignet sind! Siemens steht für Qualität, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit! Ich identifiziere mich voll und ganz mit diesen Werten. » (Process Manager) News and Stories Entdecken Sie selbst, wie technologische Innovationen bereits unser Leben verändern können. Wenn Sie mehr darüber erfahren möchten, welche Projekte mit Siemens-Technologie umgesetzt werden können, finden Sie hier einige aktuelle Beispiele. Häufig gestellte Fragen und Ihr Gesprächspartner Hier finden Sie eine Zusammenfassung der häufig gestellten Fragen und die Möglichkeit, uns direkt zu kontaktieren. Ich freue mich auf Ihre Bewerbung! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Ihre Reise zu Siemens - So stellen wir Informationen zur Personalvermittlung ein: Siemens Schweiz nimmt keine Bewerbungen aus der Personalvermittlung an. Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis.

jobs.description:
Nous relions les mondes réels et numériques en collaboration avec nos clients. Le chef de projet ou cheffe de projet en tableaux électriques basse tension, conçoit, planifie, coordonne et supervise la réalisation d’installations dans des environnements à haute exigence. Il ou elle garantit le bon fonctionnement des tableaux électriques destinés à la distribution d’énergie sensible. À ce titre, il ou elle prend en compte les aspects techniques, réglementaires, économiques et environnementaux, tout engarantissant le respect des normes et directives en vigueur ainsi que des exigences spécifiques des clients. Ce rôle implique une forte technicité, une grande autonomie ainsi qu’une forte mobilité, avec des déplacements fréquents sur site. Il implique également la gestion des relations clients et la conduite d’interventions, qu’elles soient planifiées ou réalisées en urgence. Tu aimerais toi aussi contribuer aux prochaines innovations et améliorer la vie de millions de personnes en Suisse ? Alors ce poste est fait pour toi ! Dépose ta candidature dès aujourd’hui en tant que Chef de projet tableaux électriques basse-tension 80-100% (f/h/d) – Ton équipe se réjouit de t’accueillir ! Vos nouvelles tâches
• Offrir, élaborer, planifier et conduire des projets d’envergures dans le domaine des tableaux électriques bâtiment et industriel
• Etudier, calculer et négocier les dossiers d’offres et de soumissions
• Planifier, conduire et suivre la réalisation des projets tableaux électriques en relation avec la production
• Développer et fidéliser les relations professionnelles avec les bureaux d’ingénieurs, maîtres d’ouvrage et prescripteurs
• Apporter des solutions techniques innovantes dans le domaine des tableaux électriques Vos talents et votre expérience
• Technicien ES, brevet fédéral de chef de projet en construction de tableaux électriques, ingénieur HES, planificateur électricien, automaticien ou installateur électricien diplômé
• A l’aise avec les outils informatiques, la connaissance des programmes EPLAN, AutoCad ou Revit est un atout
• Connaissances en distribution et normes électriques, NIBT et automatisation.
• Bonnes compétences communicationnelles, aisance dans la rédaction et la présentation de documents techniques et orienté clientèle.
• Autonomie, rigueur, capacité à travailler sous pression et gérer les priorités.
• Très bonnes connaissances du français, avec des compétences en allemand ou en anglais appréciées
• Connaissance dans le domaine des rails d’énergie ou de la moyenne-tension est un plus. Vos avantages
• 2 à 3 jours/semaine de travail mobile par défaut
• Abonnement de transports publics à prix réduit et stationnement gratuit
• Nombreuses opportunités de développement et de formation continue
• Accès aux plans d’actionnariat pour les membres du personnel
• Retrouve tous les avantages ici Notre culture d’entreprise – ton nouvel environnement de travail La culture de Siemens Suisse est bien plus qu’un simple environnement de travail : elle est au cœur de notre collaboration quotidienne et la clé de notre succès. Siemens Suisse offre un environnement de travail tourné vers l’avenir, faisant la part belle à l’innovation, au développement durable et à l’épanouissement personnel. Nous nous distinguons par notre responsabilité individuelle, l’égalité des chances et la diversité, qui permettent à chaque collaborateur et collaboratrice de s’investir de manière authentique. Nous mettons en œuvre des modèles de travail flexibles et le travail mobile afin de permettre à notre personnel de trouver un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée. Retrouve plus d’informations et découvre avec notre quiz culture si tu conviens à Siemens ! « Siemens fait partie des pionniers de la technologie et je suis fière d’écrire son histoire avec elle. » (Responsable d’équipe) Actualités et stories Découvre par toi-même à quel point les innovations technologiques peuvent déjà transformer notre vie. Si tu veux en savoir plus sur les projets qui peuvent être mis en œuvre à l’aide de la technologie Siemens, tu trouveras ici quelques exemples actuels . Questions fréquentes et votre interlocuteur ou interlocutrice Tu trouveras ici une synthèse des questions fréquemment posées ainsi que la possibilité de nous contacter directement. J’attends votre candidature avec impatience ! Connettiamo mondi reali e digitali in collaborazione con i nostri clienti. Il project manager o project leader in pannelli elettrici a bassa tensione, progetta, progetta, coordina e supervisiona l'implementazione di impianti in ambienti ad alta domanda. Garantisce il corretto funzionamento dei pannelli elettrici destinati alla distribuzione di energia sensibile. In quanto tale, tiene conto degli aspetti tecnici, normativi, economici e ambientali, garantendo al tempo stesso il rispetto delle norme e delle direttive esistenti e delle specifiche esigenze dei clienti. Questo ruolo implica alta tecnicità, elevata autonomia e elevata mobilità, con frequenti movimenti in loco. Si tratta anche di gestire le relazioni con i clienti e di condurre interventi, sia pianificati che effettuati in caso di emergenza. Vuoi contribuire alle prossime innovazioni e migliorare la vita di milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora questo lavoro e' per te! • Offrire, sviluppare, pianificare e condurre grandi progetti nel campo della costruzione e dei pannelli elettrici industriali
• Studiare, calcolare e negoziare i file di offerta e di offerta

• Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni professionali con uffici di ingegneria, appaltatori e prescrittori
• Fornire soluzioni tecniche innovative nel campo dei pannelli elettrici Il vostro talento e l'esperienza
• ES Tecnico, Brevetto Federale per Leader del Progetto nella Costruzione di Equitazione Elettrica, Ingegnere HES, Pianificatore Elettrico, Installatore Elettrico Automatico o Laureato
• Facile con strumenti informatici, la conoscenza dei programmi EPLAN, AutoCad o Revit è un bene
• Conoscenza della distribuzione e degli standard elettrici, NIBT e automazione.
• Buone capacità di comunicazione, facilità di scrittura e presentazione di documenti tecnici e orientati al cliente.
• Autonomia, rigore, capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e gestire le priorità.
• Molto buona conoscenza del francese, con apprezzate competenze tedesche o inglesi
• La conoscenza nel campo dell'energia o delle ferrovie di media tensione è un plus. I tuoi vantaggi
• da 2 a 3 giorni / settimana di lavoro mobile per impostazione predefinita
• Abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici a prezzi ridotti e parcheggio gratuito
• Molte opportunità di sviluppo e formazione
• Accesso ai piani azionari dei dipendenti

Realizziamo modelli di lavoro flessibili e lavoro mobile per consentire al nostro personale di trovare un equilibrio tra lavoro e privacy. descriptionByLocale.en:
We connect real and digital worlds in collaboration with our customers. The project manager or project leader in low voltage electrical panels, designs, plans, coordinates and supervises the implementation of installations in high demand environments. It guarantees the proper functioning of electrical panels intended for the distribution of sensitive energy. As such, it takes into account technical, regulatory, economic and environmental aspects, while ensuring compliance with existing standards and directives as well as specific customer requirements. This role implies high technicality, high autonomy and high mobility, with frequent on-site movements. It also involves managing customer relationships and conducting interventions, whether planned or carried out in an emergency. Would you like to contribute to the next innovations and improve the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then this job is for you! Apply today as Project Leader low voltage electrical panels 80-100% (e/h/d) – Your team is looking forward to welcoming you! Your new tasks
• Offer, develop, plan and conduct major projects in the field of building and industrial electrical panels
• Study, calculate and negotiate bid and bid files
• Planning, leading and monitoring the implementation of electrical array projects in relation to production
• Develop and maintain professional relations with engineering offices, contractors and prescribers
• Providing innovative technical solutions in the field of electrical panels Your talents and experience
• ES Technician, Federal Patent for Project Leader in Electrical Board Construction, HES Engineer, Electrical Planner, Automatician or Graduate Electrical Installer
• Easy with computer tools, knowledge of EPLAN, AutoCad or Revit programs is an asset
• Knowledge of distribution and electrical standards, NIBT and automation.
• Good communication skills, ease of writing and presentation of technical and customer-oriented documents.
• Autonomy, rigor, ability to work under pressure and manage priorities.
• Very good knowledge of French, with appreciated German or English skills
• Knowledge in the field of energy or medium voltage rails is a plus. Your Benefits
• 2 to 3 days/week of mobile work by default
• Public transport subscription at reduced prices and free parking
• Many opportunities for development and further training
• Access to employee share plans
• Find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment Siemens Switzerland's culture is much more than just a work environment: it is at the heart of our daily collaboration and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a forward-looking working environment, with a focus on innovation, sustainable development and personal development. We distinguish ourselves by our individual responsibility, equality of opportunity and diversity, which allow each employee to invest in a genuine way. We implement flexible work models and mobile work to enable our staff to find a balance between work and privacy. Find more information and discover with our culture quiz if you agree to Siemens! "I am proud to write her story with Siemens as a pioneer in technology. » (Team Manager) News and Stories Find out for yourself how technological innovations can already transform our lives. If you want to know more about projects that can be implemented using Siemens technology, here you will find some current examples. Frequently asked questions and your interlocutor Here you will find a summary of frequently asked questions and the possibility of contacting us directly. I'm looking forward to your application! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Your journey to Siemens - How we hire Information on the placement of staff: Siemens Switzerland does not accept applications from the placement of staff. Thank you for your understanding.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir verbinden reale und digitale Welten in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Der Projektmanager oder Projektleiter in Niederspannungs-Elektrikmodulen entwirft, plant, koordiniert und überwacht die Implementierung von Installationen in Umgebungen mit hohem Bedarf. Es garantiert das ordnungsgemäße Funktionieren von elektrischen Schalttafeln für die Verteilung empfindlicher Energie. Als solches berücksichtigt es technische, regulatorische, wirtschaftliche und ökologische Aspekte und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung bestehender Normen und Richtlinien sowie spezifischer Kundenanforderungen sicher. Diese Rolle impliziert eine hohe technische Qualität, hohe Autonomie und hohe Mobilität mit häufigen Bewegungen vor Ort. Es beinhaltet auch die Verwaltung der Kundenbeziehungen und die Durchführung von Interventionen, ob geplant oder im Notfall durchgeführt. Möchten Sie zu den nächsten Innovationen beitragen und das Leben von Millionen Menschen in der Schweiz verbessern? Dann ist dieser Job für Sie! Bewerben Sie sich noch heute als Projektleiter Niederspannungs-Elektropaneele 80-100% (e/h/d) – Ihr Team freut sich darauf, Sie willkommen zu heißen! Ihre neuen Aufgaben
• Anbieten, Entwickeln, Planen und Durchführen von Großprojekten im Bereich der Bau- und Industrieelektrik
• Studie, Berechnung und Verhandlung von Gebots- und Gebotsdateien
• Planung, Leitung und Überwachung der Durchführung von elektrischen Array-Projekten in Bezug auf die Produktion
• Aufbau und Pflege professioneller Beziehungen zu Ingenieurbüros, Auftragnehmern und Verschreibenden
• Bereitstellung innovativer technischer Lösungen im Bereich der elektrischen Schalttafeln Ihre Talente und Erfahrungen
• ES-Techniker, Bundespatent für Projektleiter im Elektrikbau, HES-Ingenieur, Elektroplaner, Automatiker oder Diplom-Elektroinstallateur
• Einfach mit Computer-Tools, Wissen über EPLAN, AutoCad oder Revit-Programme ist eine Bereicherung
• Kenntnisse der Verteilung und elektrischen Standards, NIBT und Automatisierung.
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, einfaches Schreiben und Präsentation von technischen und kundenorientierten Dokumenten.
• Autonomie, Strenge, Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten und Prioritäten zu verwalten.
• Sehr gute Französischkenntnisse, mit geschätzten Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnissen
• Wissen im Bereich Energie- oder Mittelspannungsschienen ist ein Plus. Ihre Vorteile
• 2 bis 3 Tage/Woche mobile Arbeit standardmäßig
• Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zu reduzierten Preisen und kostenlose Parkplätze
• Viele Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und Weiterbildung
• Zugang zu Mitarbeiteraktienplänen
• Alle Vorteile finden Sie hier Unsere Unternehmenskultur – Ihre neue Arbeitswelt Die Kultur von Siemens Schweiz ist viel mehr als nur ein Arbeitsumfeld: Sie steht im Mittelpunkt unserer täglichen Zusammenarbeit und ist der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsweisendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Fokus auf Innovation, nachhaltige Entwicklung und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir zeichnen uns durch unsere individuelle Verantwortung, Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt aus, die es jedem Mitarbeiter ermöglichen, wirklich zu investieren. Wir implementieren flexible Arbeitsmodelle und mobiles Arbeiten, damit unsere Mitarbeiter ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Arbeit und Privatsphäre finden. Finden Sie weitere Informationen und entdecken Sie mit unserem Kulturquiz, wenn Sie Siemens zustimmen! Ich bin stolz darauf, ihre Geschichte mit Siemens als Pionier in der Technologie zu schreiben. » (Team Manager) News und Stories Erfahren Sie selbst, wie technologische Innovationen bereits unser Leben verändern können. Wenn Sie mehr über Projekte erfahren möchten, die mit Siemens-Technologie umgesetzt werden können, finden Sie hier einige aktuelle Beispiele. Häufig gestellte Fragen und Ihr Gesprächspartner Hier finden Sie eine Zusammenfassung der häufig gestellten Fragen und die Möglichkeit, uns direkt zu kontaktieren. Ich freue mich auf Ihre Bewerbung! jobs.description:
Wir suchen nach Menschen, die mit uns die Digitalisierung von Morgen gestalten. Denn – Wir machen digital. Willkommen bei Siemens Digital Industries Software. Wir sind ein dynamisches Softwareunternehmen, das beständig wächst und unseren Kunden bereits heute die Technologien und Innovationen von morgen liefert. Durch die Stärken eines Unternehmens wie Siemens sind Deine Möglichkeiten grenzenlos. Die Siemens Digital Industries Software ist die Software-Säule von Siemens. Wir begeistern, unterstützen und beraten unsere Kund*innen in jeglichen Fragestellungen rund um das Thema Software – mit Fokus auf die unterschiedlichen Industriezweige. Mit dem weltweit umfangreichsten Portfolio im Bereich Industriesoftware gestalten wir die Digitalisierung von morgen! Hast Du Lust anzupacken, Dinge neu zu denken und direkt am Herzen der digitalen Transformation zu arbeiten? Dann bewirb Dich und starte Deine Zukunft mit uns – als Sales Executive gestaltest Du Innovation aktiv mit. Welche Rolle wirst Du spielen? In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du aktiv den Ausbau unseres Software-Geschäfts bei Kunden aus dem Bereich Pharma & CPG. Unser Ziel ist es, den Kunden durch innovative, digitale Lösungen nachhaltig zu begeistern – und das erreichen wir gemeinsam, agil und mit klarem Fokus auf Mehrwert.
• Du analysierst den Markt systematisch, beobachtest technologische Trends und entwickelst daraus konkrete Ansätze zur Erweiterung unseres Kundenportfolios
• Auf Basis dieser Erkenntnisse entwickelst Du kundenindividuelle, global ausgerichtete Vertriebsstrategien und bringst neue, zukunftsweisende Lösungen aus unserem stetig wachsenden Portfolio in die bestehende Systemlandschaft des Kunden ein
• Du agierst als kompetenter Ansprechpartner*in auf allen Ebenen – auch auf C-Level – und vertrittst unsere Themen mit Klarheit, Überzeugung und unternehmerischem Gespür
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kunden und unseren interdisziplinären Teams entwickelst Du maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für Engineering- und Produktionsumgebungen, einschließlich aller relevanten Domänen
• Du führst den Kunden durch den gesamten Entscheidungsprozess, stellst den konkreten Nutzen verständlich dar und treibst Projekte mit der nötigen Beharrlichkeit bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss
• Im gesamten Sales-Zyklus übernimmst Du die Rolle des Orchestrators: Du koordinierst alle internen und externen Beteiligten – von PreSales über Service bis hin zu R&D – und sorgst dafür, dass wir als starkes, agiles Team auftreten Wie wirst Du Teil unseres Teams? Mit Leidenschaft und Mut!
• Du brennst für gute Ideen: Als kreative, engagierte Persönlichkeit denkst Du unternehmerisch, schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und findest für jede Herausforderung eine smarte Lösung
• Du kannst Menschen gewinnen: Mit Fingerspitzengefühl und Überzeugungskraft baust Du tragfähige Beziehungen auf – besonders auf C-Level wirst Du als Partner auf Augenhöhe geschätzt
• Du bist ein Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne im Schulterschluss mit Kolleg*innen aus Vertrieb, PreSales, Service und Entwicklung mit der Überzeugung, dass wir nur gemeinsam erfolgreich sind
• Du kennst das Geschäft : Deine mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Softwarelösungen gibt Dir Sicherheit bei Verhandlungen
• Du sprichst die Sprache der Branche: Mit fundiertem Wissen zu Prozessen und Anwendungen der Industrien – vom ersten Entwicklungsschritt bis zur fertigen Produktion – trittst Du souverän auf.
• Du bist sprachlich fit: Wir verstehen unsere Kunden auf Deutsch und Englisch Bist du ein*e Ideengestalter*in? Dann werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams! Wenn du erste Fragen mit unserem Recruiting Team klären möchtest, wende Dich gerne per Mail an: globaldiswcandidateexperience.ie@siemens.com. Aufgrund der Datenschutzbestimmungen (GDPR) können wir keine Lebensläufe per E-Mail annehmen. Bitte reiche Deine Bewerbung über unser Karriere-Portal ein. Ansprechperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Markus Kies. Du möchtest vor Deiner Bewerbung mehr über Siemens Digital Industries Software erfahren? Mission / Vision und unser Software Portfolio – oder besuche unsere Homepage. Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit für alle Menschen. Insbesondere möchten wir Menschen mit Behinderung ermutigen, sich zu bewerben. Pay Transparency Die Gesamtvergütung für diese Position liegt im Bereich von CHF 171.00 bis CHF 300.800, wobei 40% davon aus einem jährlichen Anreizziel (100% Erreichung) bestehen. Die tatsächlich angebotene Vergütung basiert auf den jobspezifischen Fähigkeiten, der Erfahrung und der relevanten Ausbildung/Schulung des erfolgreichen Kandidaten. Siemens bietet Gesundheits- und Wellnessleistungen für Mitarbeiter an; Sie können auf die in Ihrem Land verfügbaren Leistungen über den folgenden Link zugreifen: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando persone che formeranno la digitalizzazione di domani con noi. Perché – facciamo digitale. Benvenuti al software Siemens Digital Industries. Siamo una società di software dinamica che cresce costantemente e già oggi offre le tecnologie e le innovazioni di domani ai nostri clienti. Con i punti di forza di un'azienda come Siemens, le tue possibilità sono infinite. Siemens Digital Industries Il software è il pilastro software di Siemens. Ispiriamo, supportiamo e consigliamo ai nostri clienti su qualsiasi problema software – con un focus sulle diverse industrie. Con il portafoglio software industriale più completo al mondo, stiamo plasmando la digitalizzazione di domani! Vuoi affrontare, ripensare le cose e lavorare direttamente al cuore della trasformazione digitale? Poi applica e inizia il tuo futuro con noi – come Sales Executive fornisci attivamente innovazione. descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. The energy market depends on partners who can offer marketable solutions with comprehensive services and innovative ideas. We are professionals in this. Energy production, transmission and distribution as well as management systems, automation and control technology are the main pillars of our business area. Protection systems for high and medium voltage systems secure our energy supply. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply as a specialist today: in medium-voltage technologies 80-100% – your team is looking forward to you! Your new tasks
• Responsibility for the active sales support of medium-voltage installations (concept definitions, project planning, preparation of offers, prices and presentations of offers)
• Project management with full cost, deadline and quality responsibility incl. Assembly and commissioning coordination with subsequent transfer to the clientele
• Support and training of customers: on-site for our products and plants in the medium-voltage sector
• Responsibility for customer acceptance of our plants and systems at the various Siemens plants
• Active participation in customer events and trade fairs
• Maintaining contact with internal and external bodies, especially with the RU clientele, our parent company and our engineering offices Your talents and experience
• Training as an electrical engineer: in FH/HF, ideally specialisation in energy engineering or comparable training
• Experience in project planning, of advantage in the field of energy technology
• Customer knowledge (EVUs) in the Swiss energy market is an advantage
• Communicative and customer-oriented personality who wants to contribute and develop the technical know-how
• Self-employed and organised working practices
• Very good knowledge of German; English and French skills or Italian benefit your advantages
• 2–3 days/week mobile work is standard
• Discounted ÖV subscription and free parking
• Diverse training opportunities
• Access to employee stock plans
• You can find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! “Siemens is one of the pioneers of technology, and being part of it makes me kind of proud.” (Team Leader at Siemens) News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. I look forward to your application. Alina Talent Acquisition Partner Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens Switzerland does not accept recruitment applications for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The Fire Application team develops fire safety products with great passion and dedication. Our state-of-the-art fire alarm systems provide people and equipment around the world with 24-hour protection against fire damage – in line with our motto “We make the world a safer place”. Siemens' global center for the development of fire protection systems, which set standards worldwide, is located in Zug. As we move towards digitalization, the Fire Application team is also working on linking our products to cloud-based systems. We strive to incorporate advanced security concepts to ensure robust protection for our software and data. With its broad expertise in the areas of distributed systems, real-time and embedded software, the team assumes responsibility for implementing the defined goals in many development projects. The team is being further expanded considering the growing number of international projects, which increasingly involve technologies from the fields of edge and cloud computing. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of IoT Software Engineer Fire Systems – your team is looking forward to meeting you! Your new responsibilities
• You will be working in a cross-functional, agile team, playing a decisive role in defining the function and design of software components and assuming responsibility for them over the course of time
• The scope of responsibilities ranges from software design to the delivery of market-ready solutions for our customers
• You will be responsible for implementing security guidelines to ensure that our software meets the highest standards of protection and compliance
• By continuously applying and improving test strategies, you will ensure that our products meet our strict quality requirements
• You will be working globally with internal and external colleagues, customers, suppliers, universities and other development departments
• You will assume responsibility for your own work and use the freedom given to you to achieve the best possible solutions
• Our agile working environment makes it possible to respond to changing market needs with custom-made solutions
• By mutual agreement and depending on your interests and skills, there are many opportunities to take on further responsibilities in the areas of technology, security, architecture and project management Your talents and experience
• Education : Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or electrical engineering with an emphasis on software development

En combinant les mondes réel et numérique, nous donnons à nos clients les moyens d'atteindre leurs objectifs de décarbonisation, de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation et de créer des expériences d'occupant de classe mondiale pour leur peuple. Il ne s'agit pas seulement d'améliorer les bâtiments – il s'agit de créer des environnements efficaces, sûrs, adaptables et durables, qui améliorent la façon dont le monde vit et fonctionne. L'équipe Fire Application développe des produits de sécurité incendie avec une grande passion et dévouement. Nos systèmes d'alarme incendie à la fine pointe de la technologie offrent aux personnes et aux équipements du monde entier une protection 24 heures sur 24 contre les dommages causés par l'incendie, conformément à notre devise « Nous faisons du monde un endroit plus sûr ». Siemens' centre mondial pour le développement de systèmes de protection contre l'incendie, qui établissent des normes dans le monde, est situé à Zug. À mesure que nous nous dirigeons vers la numérisation, l'équipe de l'application Fire travaille également à lier nos produits aux systèmes basés sur le cloud. Nous nous efforçons d'intégrer des concepts de sécurité avancés pour assurer une protection robuste de nos logiciels et données. Grâce à sa vaste expertise dans les domaines des systèmes distribués, des logiciels en temps réel et intégrés, l'équipe assume la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre des objectifs définis dans de nombreux projets de développement. L'équipe est en cours d'expansion compte tenu du nombre croissant de projets internationaux, qui impliquent de plus en plus des technologies de pointe et de cloud computing. Aimeriez-vous également jouer un rôle actif dans l'influence des tendances et des évolutions actuelles et avoir un impact positif sur la vie de millions de personnes en Suisse? • D'un commun accord et en fonction de vos intérêts et de vos compétences, il y a de nombreuses possibilités d'assumer d'autres responsabilités dans les domaines de la technologie, de la sécurité, de l'architecture et de la gestion de projet.

jobs.description:
Youtube Video Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. We are looking for a motivated colleague as Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems for our global Buildings Business Unit. In this role you are responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving high‑quality technical training programs related to Siemens’ fire detection and safety systems. You translate complex technical, regulatory, and system-related topics into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences for internal employees, customers, and partners. You combine deep technical expertise with strong didactic skills and collaborate closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure training content is aligned with product developments, regulatory requirements, and customer needs. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? Location : this position will be based in Zug/Switzerland. Prerequisite is your legal eligibility to work in Switzerland. Your new responsibilities
• Training Program Development: Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive technical training concepts and curricula for fire safety systems and solutions, translating complex regulations and architectures into practical, learner-focused content for various target groups (Technical Engineers, Technical Technicians, Project Managers, Technical Support, and End Users)
• Training Delivery & Facilitation: Plan, organize, and conduct engaging technical fire safety trainings in diverse formats (classroom, virtual, hybrid), facilitating both theoretical sessions and practical, system-based exercises for all skill levels
• Learning Content Creation & Management: Develop, update, and manage high-quality learning assets, including documentation, presentations, manuals, exercises, and digital content (e.g., e-learning, videos), ensuring alignment with current regulations and product releases
• Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Collaborate closely with internal teams (Product Management, R&D, Technical support, ) to align training content with product updates, regulatory changes, and customer requirements
• Quality Assurance & Continuous Learning: Collect participant feedback to continuously improve training quality, actively supporting knowledge transfer and fostering a culture of continuous learning within the organization
• Special Projects & Mentoring: Support or lead certification/approval programs, contribute to global/regional training initiatives, and coach/mentor subject matter experts and junior trainers Your skills and experience
• Technical degree in electrical engineering, fire safety, building technologies, or a related field
• Proven experience with fire detection or safety systems, coupled with a strong understanding of relevant regulations, standards, and system architectures (certification is a plus)
• Demonstrated experience in technical training, knowledge transfer, or a comparable role, ideally including familiarity with digital learning formats and e-learning tools
• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear, practical, and engaging content for diverse audiences
• Structured, self-organized, and quality-oriented working style, comfortable with various learning formats (classroom, virtual, hybrid)
• Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder management skills, ideally gained within an international or matrix organization
• Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in German is a significant advantage What We Offer
• A challenging and impactful role at the cutting edge of fire safety technology
• High level of responsibility and autonomy in shaping technical training
• Close collaboration with experts across engineering, product development, and project teams
• Opportunities to drive global training concepts and foster continuous improvement
• Dedicated support for your professional development and continuous learning
• Further information about employee benefits can be found here What it’s like working for us We place significant emphasis on fostering an inclusive and flexible working culture that encourages everyone to be their authentic selves. Equal opportunities and diversity are important to us and contribute to an enriching culture. We actively embrace mobile working to provide every colleague with more autonomy and the chance to achieve a good work-life balance. Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici – si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. Stiamo cercando un collega motivato come Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems per la nostra Global Buildings Business Unit. In questo ruolo sei responsabile della progettazione, della fornitura e del miglioramento continuo dei programmi di formazione tecnica di alta qualità relativi ai sistemi di rilevamento e sicurezza antincendio di Siemens. Traduci argomenti tecnici, normativi e legati al sistema in esperienze di apprendimento chiare, pratiche e coinvolgenti per dipendenti, clienti e partner interni. Combinate competenze tecniche profonde con forti competenze didattiche e collaborate a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire che i contenuti di formazione siano allineati agli sviluppi dei prodotti, ai requisiti normativi e alle esigenze dei clienti. • Sviluppo del programma di formazione: progettazione, sviluppo e mantenimento di concetti di formazione tecnica e curricula completi per sistemi e soluzioni di sicurezza antincendio, traducendo complesse normative e architetture in contenuti pratici e mirati agli studenti per vari gruppi target (Ingegneri tecnici, Tecnici tecnici, Project Manager, Supporto tecnico e Utenti finali)
• Training Delivery & Facilitation: Pianificare, organizzare e condurre allenamenti tecnici di sicurezza antincendio in diversi formati (classe, virtuale, ibrido), facilitando sia sessioni teoriche che esercitazioni pratiche, basate sul sistema per tutti i livelli di abilità
• Creazione e gestione dei contenuti di apprendimento: sviluppare, aggiornare e gestire attività di apprendimento di alta qualità, tra cui documentazione, presentazioni, manuali, esercizi e contenuti digitali (ad esempio, e-learning, video), assicurando l'allineamento con le normative attuali e le versioni dei prodotti
• Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team interni (Product Management, R&D, Supporto tecnico, ) per allineare i contenuti formativi con gli aggiornamenti dei prodotti, i cambiamenti normativi e i requisiti dei clienti
• Quality Assurance & Continuous Learning: Raccogliere feedback dei partecipanti per migliorare continuamente la qualità della formazione, sostenere attivamente il trasferimento della conoscenza e promuovere una cultura dell'apprendimento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione
• Progetti speciali & Mentoring: Sostegno o lead programmi di certificazione/approvazione, contribuire a iniziative di formazione globale/regionale, e coach/mentor soggetti esperti e formatori junior Le tue competenze ed esperienza

• Esperienza comprovata con sistemi antincendio o di sicurezza, accoppiata con una forte comprensione delle normative, degli standard e delle architetture di sistema (la certificazione è un plus)
• Esperienza dimostrata nella formazione tecnica, nel trasferimento di conoscenze o in un ruolo paragonabile, tra cui la familiarità con i formati di apprendimento digitale e gli strumenti di e-learning

It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. We are looking for a motivated colleague as Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems for our global Buildings Business Unit. In this role you are responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving high‑quality technical training programs related to Siemens’ fire detection and safety systems. You translate complex technical, regulatory, and system-related topics into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences for internal employees, customers, and partners. You combine deep technical expertise with strong didactic skills and collaborate closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure training content is aligned with product developments, regulatory requirements, and customer needs. • Training Program Development: Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive technical training concepts and curricula for fire safety systems and solutions, translating complex regulations and architectures into practical, learner-focused content for various target groups (Technical Engineers, Technical Technicians, Project Managers, Technical Support, and End Users)

• Special Projects & Mentoring: Support or lead certification/approval programs, contribute to global/regional training initiatives, and coach/mentor subject matter experts and junior trainers Your skills and experience

Vidéo Youtube Avec nos clients, nous combinons les mondes réel et numérique Avec la technologie, les logiciels et les services pour les bâtiments intelligents, nous transformons le quotidien pour tout le monde. En combinant les mondes réel et numérique, nous donnons à nos clients les moyens d'atteindre leurs objectifs de décarbonisation, de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation et de créer des expériences d'occupant de classe mondiale pour leur peuple. Il ne s'agit pas seulement d'améliorer les bâtiments – il s'agit de créer des environnements efficaces, sûrs, adaptables et durables, qui améliorent la façon dont le monde vit et fonctionne. La transformation numérique des bâtiments est un secteur dynamique et en évolution rapide, qui a besoin de plus que d'une grande technologie. Nous savons qu'une entreprise ne prospère que si ses gens prospèrent, donc chez Siemens nous mettons nos gens en premier. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un collègue motivé comme Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems pour notre unité d'affaires mondiale des bâtiments. Dans ce rôle, vous êtes responsable de la conception, de la prestation et de l'amélioration continue de programmes de formation technique de haute qualité liés aux systèmes de détection et de sécurité d'incendie Siemens. Vous traduisez des sujets techniques, réglementaires et systémiques complexes en expériences d'apprentissage claires, pratiques et stimulantes pour les employés, les clients et les partenaires internes. Vous combinez une expertise technique approfondie avec de solides compétences didactiques et vous collaborez étroitement avec les intervenants interfonctionnels pour s'assurer que le contenu de formation est aligné sur les développements de produits, les exigences réglementaires et les besoins des clients. Notre voyage partagé pourrait vous emmener n'importe où... où aimeriez-vous aller ? Localisation : cette position sera basée à Zug/Suisse. • Élaboration de programmes de formation : Concevoir, élaborer et maintenir des concepts et des programmes de formation technique complets pour les systèmes et les solutions de sécurité-incendie, traduire des règlements et des architectures complexes en contenus pratiques axés sur l'apprenant pour divers groupes cibles (ingénieurs techniques, techniciens techniques, gestionnaires de projets, soutien technique et utilisateurs finaux)

You are part of our automation, test engineering and robotics team and actively design the next generation of production systems. We are developing a highly modular, value-stream-oriented automation concept – and this is where you come in: Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply today as Automation & Robotics System Engnieer 80-100% and start immediately or by appointment – your team is looking forward to you! Your new tasks
• Responsibility for the control and systemic architecture of novel modular automatic cells
• You drive the development of modular, flexible production systems along the value stream

In questo ruolo, siete responsabili del funzionamento stabile, sicuro e orientato al futuro dei nostri sistemi IT e OT orientati alla produzione e contribuire attivamente alla vostra competenza per l'ulteriore sviluppo dell'infrastruttura. È possibile aspettarsi un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con un moderno e ampio paesaggio IT/OT composto da diverse centinaia di client, un numero doppio di sistemi server altamente disponibili, una potente infrastruttura di rete e un gran numero di applicazioni orientate alla produzione. descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. For our modern production site in Zug, we are looking for a committed, practice-oriented and responsible personality as a (senior) IT/OT system engineer. In this role, you are responsible for the stable, secure and future-oriented operation of our production-oriented IT and OT systems and actively contribute your expertise to the further development of the infrastructure. You can expect a dynamic work environment with a modern, broad-based IT/OT landscape comprising several hundred clients, a double-digit number of highly available server systems, a powerful network infrastructure and a large number of production-oriented applications. At the same time, you will become part of a diverse medium-sized team that combines different age groups, experiences and nationalities. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people around the world better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply today as an IT/OT System Engineer – your team is looking forward to you! Your new tasks
• Responsibility for stable, secure and highly available operations as well as the further development of the local IT infrastructure in the OT environment, including analysis, correction and sustainable prevention of disruptions in operational operations
• Coordination and close cooperation with external partners, combined with a strong understanding of services towards production as an internal customer
• Administration, support and further development of Windows clients, Windows servers and central Microsoft, network, server and domain services
• Participation in the implementation of cybersecurity measures in the OT environment
• Willingness to provide alternate piketting services and assignments outside regular working hours
• Support and management of technical projects and subprojects Your talents and experiences
• Training : Completed basic training with further training (uni, FH, HF) in computer science, electrical engineering or a comparable field
• Experience and knowledge :
• At least 5 years of professional experience in a comparable environment
• In-depth knowledge of Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows Server and the modern Microsoft product range
• Good knowledge of Active Directory, Networks, DNS, DHCP, Azure, MS SQL, Hyper-V, PowerShell and Android or similar technologies
• Linux skills are beneficial
• Strong understanding of the importance of cybersecurity in production environments
• Working method: Structured, analytical and solution-oriented working method; Good communication skills and strong teamwork skills
• Language skills: Confident knowledge of German in words and writing, every other language is a plus your advantages
• 2–3 days/week mobile work is standard
• Mobility fee
• Diverse training opportunities
• Access to employee stock plans
• You can find all the advantages here Our corporate culture - your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. I look forward to your application. Nathalie Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens - How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens Switzerland does not accept recruitment applications for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of Embedded Linux Software Engineer. Join our core team dedicated to developing the next generation of intelligent and connected building systems. We are at the forefront of significantly improving energy efficiency and user friendliness in autonomous buildings, where technology interacts seamlessly with people, systems, and external elements Your new responsibilities
• Design and develop embedded software and architecture for Linux-based edge devices, using containerization technologies for scalable deployment in building automation environments
• Implement, test, maintain, and continuously improve software for secure, reliable, and high-quality device operation using modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD automation
• Drive technical quality through clear documentation, issue analysis, bug fixing, and effective source code management
• Collaborate with global colleagues on requirements, feature refinement, and release activities while taking ownership of topics end to end
• Contribute to reusable internal and open-source components with an open mindset and an upstream-first approach
• Take on the scrum master role for the team and support agile ways of working with a focus on customer centricity, continuous improvement, and timely delivery Your talents and experience
• A master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable technical field
• Several years of experience in professional software development and object-oriented design
• Strong programming skills in Rust/C++; knowledge of Go is a plus
• Solid expertise in software engineering for embedded Linux systems, ideally including Yocto Project
• Hands-on experience with networking and connectivity topics such as TCP/IP, IPv6, MQTT, mDNS, firewall concepts and more
• Familiarity with containerization and application management, ideally with Podman
• Experience with modern development practices, including the effective use of AI-assisted development tools, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation
• Confidence working in agile environments, ideally with experience as a scrum master enabling effective collaboration and continuous improvement
• Knowledge of building automation or IoT protocols such as BACnet/SC, Modbus, KNX, M-Bus, CoAP, Thread, KNX IoT, or HTTP is an advantage
• Experience with SBOM generation processes, standards, and tools (e.g., in the context of the Cyber Resilience Act) is an advantage
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset, strong communication skills, and a clear willingness to take ownership
• Fluent English; German language skills are beneficial Employee benefits
• 2–3 days per week of mobile working is standard
• Mobility allowance
• Varied further training opportunities
• Access to employee share programs

Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. descriptionByLocale.it:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo i mondi reali e digitali Con tecnologia, software e servizi per edifici intelligenti, trasformiamo il quotidiano per tutti. Combinando i mondi reali e digitali, possiamo permettere ai nostri clienti di raggiungere i loro obiettivi di decarbonizzazione, abbassare i costi operativi e creare esperienze occupanti di livello mondiale per la loro gente. Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici – si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. All'interno del nostro business di edifici, il nostro team globale diversificato vi sosterrà attraverso la vostra carriera e vi sfiderà a crescere in modi nuovi ed eccitanti, come trasformiamo l'infrastruttura del mondo. Vorresti anche svolgere un ruolo attivo nell'influenzare le tendenze e gli sviluppi attuali e avere un impatto positivo sulla vita di milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora siete venuti nel posto giusto! Applicare oggi per la posizione di Embedded Linux Software Engineer. Unisciti al nostro core team dedicato allo sviluppo della prossima generazione di sistemi di costruzione intelligenti e collegati. Siamo in prima linea nel migliorare in modo significativo l'efficienza energetica e la cordialità degli utenti negli edifici autonomi, dove la tecnologia interagisce senza soluzione di continuità con persone, sistemi e elementi esterni Le nuove responsabilità
• Progettare e sviluppare software e architetture integrate per dispositivi edge basati su Linux, utilizzando tecnologie di containerizzazione per la distribuzione scalabile negli ambienti di automazione degli edifici
• Implementare, testare, mantenere e migliorare continuamente il software per un funzionamento sicuro, affidabile e di alta qualità del dispositivo utilizzando le moderne pratiche DevSecOps e l'automazione CI/CD
• Guidare la qualità tecnica attraverso la documentazione chiara, l'analisi dei problemi, il fissaggio dei bug e la gestione efficace del codice sorgente
• Collaborare con i colleghi globali su requisiti, funzionalità di perfezionamento e attività di rilascio, assumendo la proprietà degli argomenti finiscono per finire
• Contribuire a componenti interni e open source riutilizzabili con una mentalità aperta e un approccio upstream-first
• Assumere il ruolo di maestro di scrum per il team e sostenere modi agili di lavorare con un focus sulla centricità del cliente, il miglioramento continuo, e la consegna tempestiva Il vostro talento e l'esperienza
• Un master o laurea in Informatica, ingegneria elettrica, o un campo tecnico comparabile
• Diversi anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software professionale e nel design orientato agli oggetti
• Forte capacità di programmazione in Rust/C++; la conoscenza di Go è un plus
• Competenze solide nell'ingegneria software per sistemi Linux incorporati, idealmente incluso Yocto Project
• Esperienza pratica con argomenti di rete e connettività come TCP/IP, IPv6, MQTT, mDNS, concetti firewall e altro ancora
• Familiarità con containerizzazione e gestione delle applicazioni, idealmente con Podman
• Esperienza con pratiche di sviluppo moderne, tra cui l'uso efficace di strumenti di sviluppo assistiti da AI, Git, pipeline CI/CD, e l'automazione dei test
• Fiducia che lavora in ambienti agili, idealmente con esperienza come maestro di scrum che consente una collaborazione efficace e un miglioramento continuo
• Conoscenza dei protocolli di building automation o IoT come BACnet/SC, Modbus, KNX, M-Bus, CoAP, Thread, KNX IoT, o HTTP è un vantaggio
• L'esperienza con processi, standard e strumenti di generazione SBOM (ad esempio, nel contesto del Cyber Resilience Act) è un vantaggio
• Una mentalità proattiva, orientata alla soluzione, forti capacità di comunicazione, e una chiara volontà di prendere possesso
• Inglese fluente; Le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono benefici
• 2–3 giorni alla settimana di lavoro mobile è standard
• Indennità di mobilità
• Varie opportunità di formazione
• Accesso ai programmi di condivisione dei dipendenti
• Ulteriori informazioni sulle prestazioni dei dipendenti possono essere trovate qui La nostra cultura aziendale – il tuo nuovo ambiente di lavoro La cultura della Siemens Svizzera è più che un ambiente di lavoro – è al centro delle nostre interazioni quotidiane e della chiave del nostro successo. Siemens Svizzera offre un ambiente di lavoro orientato al futuro caratterizzato da innovazione, sostenibilità e sviluppo personale. Siamo caratterizzati da responsabilità personale, pari opportunità e diversità, a cui ogni dipendente può contribuire in modo autentico. Modelli di lavoro flessibili e lavoro a distanza sono una realtà per noi e permettono ai nostri dipendenti di raggiungere un buon equilibrio di vita lavorativa. Scopri di più e scopri se sei un buon abbinamento con Siemens prendendo il nostro quiz culturale! Scopri come la tecnologia innovativa può cambiare il presente. Se volete saperne di più su quali progetti possono essere implementati utilizzando la tecnologia Siemens, ecco alcuni esempi attuali . Domande frequenti e informazioni di contatto Qui troverete una raccolta di domande frequenti e un modo per contattarci direttamente. Non vedo l'ora di ricevere la sua candidatura. Nathalie Talent Acquisizione Partner La tua strada per Siemens - Come assumere Informazioni per le agenzie di reclutamento: Siemens non accetta richieste da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.

Avec nos clients, nous combinons les mondes réel et numérique Avec la technologie, les logiciels et les services pour les bâtiments intelligents, nous transformons le quotidien pour tout le monde. En combinant les mondes réel et numérique, nous donnons à nos clients les moyens d'atteindre leurs objectifs de décarbonisation, de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation et de créer des expériences d'occupant de classe mondiale pour leur peuple. Il ne s'agit pas seulement d'améliorer les bâtiments – il s'agit de créer des environnements efficaces, sûrs, adaptables et durables, qui améliorent la façon dont le monde vit et fonctionne. La transformation numérique des bâtiments est un secteur dynamique et en évolution rapide, qui a besoin de plus que d'une grande technologie. Nous savons qu'une entreprise ne prospère que si ses gens prospèrent, donc chez Siemens nous mettons nos gens en premier. Au sein de notre entreprise immobilière, notre équipe mondiale diversifiée vous accompagnera dans votre carrière et vous mettra au défi de croître de nouvelles façons passionnantes, alors que nous transformons l'infrastructure mondiale. Aimeriez-vous également jouer un rôle actif dans l'influence des tendances et des évolutions actuelles et avoir un impact positif sur la vie de millions de personnes en Suisse? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit ! Postulez aujourd'hui pour la position de l'ingénieur logiciel Linux Embedded. Rejoignez notre équipe de base dédiée au développement de la prochaine génération de systèmes de construction intelligents et connectés. Nous sommes à l'avant-garde de l'amélioration significative de l'efficacité énergétique et de la convivialité dans les bâtiments autonomes, où la technologie interagit de manière transparente avec les personnes, les systèmes et les éléments externes Vos nouvelles responsabilités
• Concevoir et développer des logiciels et une architecture embarqués pour les périphériques de bord basés sur Linux, en utilisant des technologies de conteneurisation pour un déploiement évolutif dans les environnements d'automatisation du bâtiment
• Mettre en œuvre, tester, entretenir et améliorer continuellement les logiciels pour un fonctionnement sûr, fiable et de haute qualité des appareils en utilisant les pratiques modernes DevSecOps et l'automatisation CI/CD
• Diriger la qualité technique grâce à une documentation claire, à l'analyse des problèmes, à la correction des bogues et à une gestion efficace du code source
• Collaborer avec des collègues mondiaux sur les exigences, le raffinement des caractéristiques et les activités de diffusion tout en prenant en main les sujets fin à fin
• Contribuer à la réutilisation des composants internes et open-source avec un état d'esprit ouvert et une approche en amont
• Assumer le rôle de chef de file pour l'équipe et soutenir les façons agiles de travailler en mettant l'accent sur la centricité des clients, l'amélioration continue et la livraison en temps opportun Vos talents et votre expérience
• Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en informatique, génie électrique ou domaine technique comparable
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le développement professionnel de logiciels et la conception orientée objet
• Fortes compétences en programmation dans Rust/C++; la connaissance de Go est un plus
• Expertise solide en ingénierie logicielle pour les systèmes Linux embarqués, incluant idéalement Yocto Project
• Expérience pratique avec le réseautage et les sujets de connectivité tels que TCP/IP, IPv6, MQTT, mDNS, concepts de pare-feu et plus
• Familiarité avec la conteneurisation et la gestion des applications, idéalement avec Podman
• Expérience des pratiques de développement modernes, y compris l'utilisation efficace d'outils de développement assistés par l'IA, les pipelines Git, CI/CD et l'automatisation des essais
• La confiance dans les environnements agiles, idéalement avec l'expérience comme maître de brouillage permettant une collaboration efficace et une amélioration continue
• La connaissance de l'automatisation du bâtiment ou des protocoles IoT tels que BACnet/SC, Modbus, KNX, M-Bus, CoAP, Thread, KNX IoT ou HTTP est un avantage
• L'expérience des processus, des normes et des outils de génération SBOM (p. ex. dans le contexte de la Loi sur la cyberrésilience) est un avantage
• Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la solution, de solides compétences en communication et une volonté claire d'appropriation
